'''Toybox''' was the nickname of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] who made electric toys before he was pressed into service as a technical expert by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. On the orders of [[Fixer 66]], he sabotaged comm units in order to kill any [[Balmorran resistance|resistance]] members who tried to scavenge them from corpses on the battlefield.
